column1: # Machine-readable projection of knowledge/process/delivery-phases.md.
# The Ahoy hosted harness routes stories by this file, read at the commit each
# story pins when it is created. The prose doc stays authoritative for humans
# and for what each actor does; this decides routing. Keep them in sync.
# There is no row before intake: the harness creates the story's state from
# state.template.json when the story is created through the API, and runs its
# preflight before any phase.
# kind:
#   auto           run the actor (if any), then the gate
#   implementation one run per work package; child_ready per repository, and
#                  when ALL pass, pr; then advance
#   human          advance only when a person approves human_gate_key through
#                  the API
#   terminal       stop
# actor: the agent profile in .github/agents/ that runs the phase, or a harness
#      step: `ahoy dispatch` (implementation: the implementer of each work
#      package comes from the plan and agent-mappings.md). pr_review names the
#      one reviewer agent (D17); `ahoy review` is refused.
# gate: the harness's gate for the phase. pr_review's is `review`; a row that
#      still names `consensus` halts the story before the reviewer runs.
# on_fail (gate fail): a phase name, or `stay` to remain and be re-run later.
# on_branch (gate branch): a phase name, or `-` if the gate cannot branch.
# log: decision log entry type to append, or `-` for none. Routine passing
#      transitions are not logged; the events and gate records already hold
#      them.
# interactive: ignored by the hosted harness. No run waits for a person: the
#      planner asks its questions in specs/<STORY-ID>/questions.json and stops,
#      a person answers through the API, and planning runs again.
# model / effort: what this phase's actor runs on, or `-` to say nothing.
#      What wins, first to last: a revision's override, the story's own choice
#      (through the API), the harness's phase configuration, this cell, the
#      agent profile's `model:`. The harness's built-in configuration names a
#      model for intake, planning and pr_review, so a cell here only counts
#      where the configuration names none (implementation, by default). Fill a
#      cell only to override deliberately.
#      Effort levels: low medium high xhigh max, or `-`.
# on_fail for `planning` is `stay`, not `blocked`: a planning run that ends
# without a plan (waiting on answers, or out of time) is unfinished, not
# failed, and the next run picks up where it stopped.
# design: passes as skipped unless the plan has a UI work package and the Jira
#      snapshot links a Figma node. Otherwise the harness reads the frames
#      over the Figma REST API into specs/<STORY-ID>/design/, then the actor
#      writes design/density.md, which the `design` gate judges. A rejected
#      pack halts; the reason goes to the actor's next run. When intake passes,
#      the harness also reads the frames' node trees (no images) for the
#      planner only; the design phase drops that read and reads them again.
